why: Chen and Hou (PNAS 2025) give a computer-assisted proof of finite-time singularity formation for 3D axisymmetric Euler equations with smooth initial data and a boundary, and a September 2025 DeepMind paper using physics-informed neural networks reports discovery of new families of unstable self-similar singularities in Euler-type equations, both directly bearing on blow-up/regularity of Euler solutions.
